info.description:
JSON API of the Be Aware personal finance tracker.

Success: `{"data": ...}` (lists also have `meta`). Failure: `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields"?}}`.

Money is always a string with two decimals. The session is a cookie; send the CSRF token from `GET /api/session` in an `X-CSRFToken` header on POST, PUT and DELETE.
info.title: Be Aware API
